tara_sales: Quick assist pls — Globex POC hitting 429s on embeddings during load tests. Demo in 36h. They say calls are small but highly parallel. Error: `429 Too Many Requests` with header snapshot below.

leo_sre: Share the exact headers and a sample client pattern. Is this a dedicated customer or hosted?

tara_sales: Hosted. Tenant: globex-tenant-prod. Route alias: embeddings.v2. Client pattern: Node spawn of 40 parallel requests, each single-string input. Node snippet they used: 
```js
for (let i=0;i<40;i++) {
  fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings',{
    method:'POST',
    headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${KEY}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({model:'embed-lite', input:'short text'})
  }).catch(()=>{});
}
```
Response headers when throttled: 
`X-RateLimit-Limit: 600` 
`X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` 
`X-RateLimit-Reset: 12`

evan_support: Two-tier throttling likely: per-route burst + tenant global ceiling. If they do immediate retries it's making it worse. Do they have batching available?

maya_eng: Batch suggestion: group small texts into an array to amortize per-request overhead. Example request body: `{"input":["a","b","c"]}`. Also switch to a retry policy with capped attempts and jitter.

chris_ops: Infra logs around 1751004400 show spike and per-route cap trip. Log excerpt: 
```n[1751004403] rate_limiter: tenant=globex-tenant-prod route=embeddings.v2 event=throttle reason=per_route_cap window=30s cap_tokens=15000 used=15210
```
We can provision a short-lived route burst increase (48h) or create a transient reservation on our Dedicated pool for the POC. Both need billing ok.

billing_bot: billing-bot: To raise quotas for hosted tenants, we need explicit written approval from the billing contact on file or an internal PO. Current billing contact: accounts@globex.com.

tara_sales: I'll ping accounts@globex.com for approval now. Meanwhile can support provide a JS backoff snippet I can pass to their eng?

evan_support: Sure — quick backoff example with jitter: 
```js
async function retryWithBackoff(fn, attempts=5){
  for(let i=0;i<attempts;i++){
    try{return await fn();}catch(e){
      if(i===attempts-1) throw e;
      const base = Math.min(2000, 100 * 2**i);
      const jitter = Math.random()*base;
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, base + jitter));
    }
  }
}
```
Also recommend batch size 8-12 for their payloads.

maya_eng: Note on accounting: embeddings token accounting roughly equals sum(tokenized inputs) + overhead. Small messages still count individually toward burst windows. Batching reduces both request counts and framing overhead.

leo_sre: If billing approves, ops can do a 48h route-level bump to cap_tokens=40000. Chris, any risk to other tenants?

chris_ops: Minimal if we scope to (tenant=globex-tenant-prod, route=embeddings.v2). But raising tenant-global headroom has more blast radius. We'll prefer route-scoped reservation. I'll open ticket OPS-7821 and CC finance.

deploy_bot: deploy-bot: rate-limiter v2 was rolled at 1751004200 (sha: f9d8e6). No active rollbacks.

leo_sre: Also check whether the client's retry library sets Retry-After; if not we'll see tight retry loops. If they can't change client immediately, temporary bump + close monitoring is safest.

tara_sales: Accounts replied with GO-AHEAD from accounts@globex.com and asked for an estimate of incremental cost. Billing — can you provide rough overage estimate if we bump for 48h?

billing_bot: billing-bot: Rough estimate for 48h bump -> $1100 additional for projected peak (based on 100k extra token units). Need final signoff from finance lead: finance@redwood.ai.

chris_ops: I've created OPS-7821, set scope: route bump to cap_tokens=40000 for 48h, notify SRE to monitor. Tagging @leo_sre @evan_support.

evan_support: I'll spin up a Grafana panel and set an alert for >5% 429 rate over 5m window during the bump.

maya_eng: Follow-up: after demo please share a trace sample so we can recommend long-term rate plan or Dedicated trial. Small-parallel patterns are common in their infra; batching + a steady QPS target will be more economical.

tara_sales: Great — sending them the backoff + batching patch now and confirming OPS ticket. Thanks all :pray:

leo_sre: Action items: 1) Tara to get written billing ok (done), 2) Ops to apply 48h route bump (OPS-7821), 3) Support to monitor metrics/alerts, 4) Eng to review post-demo traces.

chris_ops: Bump applied at 1751004650 for 48h -> will expire at 1751143850. Monitoring in place.

tara_sales: Demo went well — they removed immediate retries and batched; 429s dropped. Leaving thread open till post-mortem docs. :tada:
